node.title: Re: Obtaining perl-5.6.2 for modern Ubuntu
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Just a quick thought for now: have you tried [mod://Devel::PatchPerl]? If that doesn't work, you could also look at the bisect* scripts in the Porting directory of a modern Perl to see what patches it applies to get the old Perls to compile.
